title: How is da Vinci connected to Luigi?
description: An Ingres painting, a Raphael fresco, five centuries of popes and The Tonight Show connect Leonardo da Vinci to Luigi.
fun_fact: Francis I brought the Mona Lisa into the French royal collection, which is why it hangs in Paris today.
research_note: France's rulers are too short a line for a scroll, so the chain crosses from Francis I to Pope Leo X in Raphael's Coronation of Charlemagne, where the emperor wears Francis's face and the pope wears Leo's; a Vasari fresco shows Leonardo with Leo X directly, but Leonardo is only a faded profile there.
hook: What links da Vinci to Luigi?

links.line: From 1513, the line of popes ran unbroken from Leo to Pope Francis.
In 2024, Pope Francis shook hands with Jimmy Fallon at the Vatican.
In 2026, Fallon welcomed Charlie Day back to The Tonight Show.
And in 2023, Charlie Day became the voice of Luigi.
